mapper.update: /* id="mergeTech" */ MERGE INTO TECH_STACK T USING ( SELECT #{techName} TECH_NAME FROM DUAL ) S ON (LOWER(T.TECH_NAME) = LOWER(S.TECH_NAME)) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TECH_ID ,TECH_NAME ,CATEGORY ,CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( TECH_STACK_SEQ.NEXTVAL ,S.TECH_NAME ,'ETC' ,SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: /* id="selectTechId" */ SELECT TECH_ID FROM TECH_STACK WHERE LOWER(TECH_NAME) = LOWER(#{techName})
/* id="selectTechNames" */ SELECT T.TECH_NAME FROM LEARNING_TECH L JOIN TECH_STACK T ON T.TECH_ID = L.TECH_ID WHERE L.LEARNING_ID = #{learningId} ORDER BY T.TECH_NAME
